title: SSO provisioning race leaves new users without org role bindings on Private clusters
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Multiple Private deployment customers reported that newly provisioned SSO users (via SAML/SCIM) intermittently arrive in the org but have no role bindings, resulting in 403s for all API/console access. Impacted customers include two mid-market Dedicated-Private clusters and one on-prem pilot; customers observed the issue during control-plane upgrades and during high-provisioning bursts from IdP syncs.

Observed behavior: New user entries appear in the org user list (idempotent SCIM create), but the org_role table (RBAC) is blank for that user. The control plane shows the user as pending-role-assignment for 10+ minutes until a background reconciliation job fixes the binding. During that window the user cannot access any resources and is blocked from onboarding.

Why this ticket: This is a P0 customer escalation — live customers experienced onboarding outages. We need an immediate mitigation, a short-term hotfix to eliminate the race, and a longer-term robustness change to how we reconcile SSO events with RBAC in Private/control-plane upgrades.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Have a Private control plane running version private-2026.02 with SCIM connector enabled and RBAC sync enabled.
2) Trigger a bulk provisioning event from the IdP (100+ users) while performing a control plane rolling upgrade (node A draining, B promoting).
3) Observe user entries in /orgs/:org/users but missing entries in /orgs/:org/roles or org_role binding table for a subset (~2-7%) of users.
4) Attempt API call or console login as the affected user -> 403.
5) Wait ~5-30 minutes: background reconciliation cronjob picks up missing bindings and restores access.

Notes: Intermittent — not all provisioning events reproduce. Easier to reproduce with concurrent node drain and high SCIM event volume.
root_cause: Race between SCIM provisioning handler and RBAC assignment pipeline during control-plane leader handoff / node drain. When a SCIM create event arrives to a node that is mid-drain, we persist the user entity but do not enqueue the role-binding task to the durable workqueue due to a short window where leader metadata is stale. The subsequent leader election path assumes the event will be re-delivered, but our SCIM emitter is best-effort (no durable ack). Result: user exists without role bindings until periodic reconciliation runs.
mitigation:
Immediate (hotfix): 1) Update SCIM handler to write a sentinel in the durable workqueue atomically with user creation (ensures assignment work survives node drain). 2) Deploy a targeted config change to increase reconciliation frequency for affected customers (from 15m -> 1m) while hotfix is rolled. 3) Customer-facing mitigations: temporary manual role binding script for customer SREs and runbook added to escalation.

Short-term rollback-safe action: Increase background reconciliation from 15m to 1m (config + rollout) and enable verbose logging for provisioning paths. This is low-risk and already applied to one pilot cluster.
fix_plan:
1) Implement atomic enqueue in SCIM handler (code change in control-plane-provisioner service). 2) Add retry/durability to SCIM emitter so IdP events are acknowledged and retried on leadership changes. 3) Add metrics/trace when a user is created but has no role bindings; alert on >0.1% missing bindings per provisioning window. 4) Post-fix: revert high-frequency reconciliation to default and ship the durable enqueue + emitter reliability changes.

Implementation notes: Devs - Diego (owner), Priya (code review), Omar (e2e tests). Target branch private-provision-fix-ENG343210. Expect 2-day ship for hotfix, 1-week for thorough tests and rollout cadence for all Private customers.
tests:
Unit: mock SCIM create + simulated node drain to assert durable enqueue called.
Integration: spin up two-node control plane in CI, run a 200-user SCIM sync during rolling upgrade and assert no users lack role bindings.
Smoke: gated canary rollout to one pilot Private cluster, monitor 5m post-deploy.
Monitoring: add a Datadog dashboard with metric 'provisioning.missing_role_bindings' and an alert if rate > 0.1% for 10m.
rollback_plan:
For hotfix: rollback by reverting the atomic-enqueue change and re-applying increased reconciliation frequency. Operationally, if rollback needed, coordinate with customer SREs to unfreeze provisioning and run manual binding script until stable.
For large rollout: stage by stage (pilot -> 3 customers -> all) with ability to rollback per-cluster via feature flag.
